title: List scrapers API returns all 8 scrapers
description: Verify GET /api/scrapers returns all 8 scrapers with correct fields: id, name, description, status, last_run, exit_code

steps.description: Verify response is a JSON array
Verify each scraper has id, name, description, status, last_run, exit_code fields

title: Run scraper SSE returns streaming events
description: Verify GET /api/run/{id} returns SSE stream with valid run events for a known scraper

steps.description: Verify SSE events contain start, log, and complete messages

title: Batch run returns SSE stream for multiple scrapers
description: Verify POST /api/batch/run returns SSE stream and validates unknown scraper IDs

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/batch/run with valid scraper IDs
Verify SSE events contain progress updates for each scraper
Send POST request to /api/batch/run with unknown scraper IDs
Verify unknown IDs return validation errors

title: History endpoints return valid data
description: Verify GET /api/history, /api/history/metrics, and /api/history/stats return valid history and metrics

steps.description: Verify history data is a JSON array
Verify each history entry has scraper_id, status, timestamp, duration fields
Verify metrics return success rate and average duration
Verify stats return total_runs, success_rate, avg_duration

title: Preview endpoints return scraped data
description: Verify GET /api/preview/{id} returns columns and rows for class-based scrapers and warnings for legacy scripts

steps.description: Verify response has columns and rows fields
Verify legacy scraper returns preview_unavailable warning

title: Export endpoints return downloadable files
description: Verify POST /api/export returns CSV/JSON files for class-based scrapers and rejects legacy/unknown scrapers

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/export with scraper_id=xg and format=json
Send POST request to /api/export with scraper_id=xg and format=csv
Send POST request to /api/export with unknown scraper

title: Scheduler CRUD endpoints work correctly
description: Verify scheduler list, add, delete, pause, resume, and run-now endpoints

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/scheduler/add with scraper and cron fields
Verify scheduler list no longer contains deleted task

title: Diagnostic endpoints return valid data
description: Verify diagnostic run, history, and compare endpoints work for scraper analysis

steps.description: Verify diagnostic run returns analysis data
Verify diagnostic history returns array of snapshots
Verify compare returns diff between two snapshots

title: Static files are served correctly
description: Verify index.html, style.css, and script.js static files are served correctly by the backend

steps.description: Verify response contains HTML document structure
Verify CSS is served with Content-Type text/css
Verify JS is served with Content-Type application/javascript
